# OrderedListOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Options for [`OrderedList`](ordered-list.md). Intersects [`ListElementOptions`](list-element-options.md).

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type OrderedListOptions = ListElementOptions & Partial<Omit<Pick<OrderedList, (typeof ORDERED_LIST_OWN_OPTION_KEYS)[number]>, 'numberFormat'>> & {
    /** Numbering style. Accepts `'decimal' | 'upper-roman' | 'lower-roman' | 'upper-alpha' | 'lower-alpha'`. */
    numberFormat?: NumberFormatInput;
    /** List items, in order. Sugar over {@link OrderedList.addItem}. */
    items?: string[];
}
```

### `breakAllowed`

```typescript
breakAllowed?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Whether this element can be split across page boundaries. When false, the element is treated as atomic and will be moved to a new page rather than split. If it doesn't fit on a fresh page either, it renders anyway. Default is true.

### `captureName`

```typescript
captureName?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Optional author-supplied name/key surfaced in the layout snapshot. Unset by default; a future capture API can populate it.

### `color`

```typescript
color?: ColorInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Text colour. Accepts a palette token (`'slate-800'`) or hex (`'#ff00aa'`).

### `contentDirection`

```typescript
contentDirection?: ContentDirectionInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Inline progression and paragraph base direction; omitted inherits.

### `decoration`

```typescript
decoration?: TextDecorationInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Decoration. Accepts one token or a list: `['underline', 'overline']`.

### `decorationColor`

```typescript
decorationColor?: ColorInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Decoration line colour. Accepts a palette token or hex.

### `decorationStyle`

```typescript
decorationStyle?: DecorationStyleInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Decoration line style. Accepts `'solid' | 'wavy' | 'dashed' | 'dotted'`.

### `decorationThickness`

```typescript
decorationThickness?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Decoration line thickness. Accepts a length: `0.75`, `'0.5pt'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `fontFamily`

```typescript
fontFamily?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Font family name (e.g. "Helvetica", "Times", "Arial") for weight/italic resolution. When set, fontName is automatically resolved via FontFamilyResolver using the current fontWeight and italic values.

### `fontFeatures`

```typescript
fontFeatures?: Readonly<Record<string, number>> | undefined
```

*optional*

OpenType feature overrides for embedded text, such as { kern: 0, liga: 0 }.

### `fontName`

```typescript
fontName?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

The TTF/OTF path or PDF standard font name for rendering. Assigning marks the font as explicitly set, so the document-level defaultTextStyle cascade will not override it.

### `fontSize`

```typescript
fontSize?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Font size. Accepts a length: `12`, `'12pt'`, `'4mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `fontWeight`

```typescript
fontWeight?: FontWeightInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Font weight. Accepts `'bold'`, `'semi-bold'`, … or the numeric value.

### `indent`

```typescript
indent?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Marker indent. Accepts a length: `20`, `'7mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `italic`

```typescript
italic?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Whether the text should be rendered in italic/oblique style. When fontFamily is set, triggers automatic resolution. When fontFamily is not set, uses the current fontName as the base family for resolution.

### `items`

```typescript
items?: string[] | undefined
```

*optional*

List items, in order. Sugar over [`OrderedList.addItem`](ordered-list.md#additem).

### `itemSpacing`

```typescript
itemSpacing?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Gap between items. Accepts a length: `5`, `'2mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `keepWithNext`

```typescript
keepWithNext?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Keeps this element with the start of its next sibling in vertical flow.

### `letterSpacing`

```typescript
letterSpacing?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Letter spacing (tracking). Accepts a length: `0.4`, `'0.2mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `lineHeight`

```typescript
lineHeight?: number | undefined
```

*optional*

Line-height multiplier applied to font size. Defaults to 1.2 if not set. Setting this marks the property as explicitly set, preventing cascade override.

### `margin`

```typescript
margin?: ThicknessInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Margin around this element. Accepts `12`, `[h, v]`, `[l, t, r, b]` or `{ bottom: 12 }`; omitted sides are zero.

### `numberFormat`

```typescript
numberFormat?: NumberFormatInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Numbering style. Accepts `'decimal' | 'upper-roman' | 'lower-roman' | 'upper-alpha' | 'lower-alpha'`.

### `startNumber`

```typescript
startNumber?: number | undefined
```

*optional*

Starting number for the list (default: 1)

### `wordSpacing`

```typescript
wordSpacing?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Word spacing. Accepts a length: `1`, `'0.5mm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.
